iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PROFILE::ftp
       Returns the value of an FTP profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::ftp ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned FTP profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned FTP profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.
